_format.note: Compilation recipes. inputs is an array of two schools (any pair, order-insensitive). When the player picks two cards of these schools, the recipe is matched. If no recipe matches, src/compile.js falls back to a procedural synthesis. result is the resulting card id; diagnosis is the named diagnosis (added to the archive on first discovery).
_format.matchOrder: Specific card-id pairs are matched first (not yet used). Then school pairs (any-order). Otherwise fall back to procedural synthesis.
